note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a Const 14(3), 15, COS 2, 11, 15; A06b Const 14(3), 15, COS 2, 11, 15; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 7 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Costa Rica, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Costa Rica for at least 7 years. If citizen by birth of Spain, a Central American country or an Iberoamerican country, residence for at least 5 years. ... n.a. (Person must make a declaration of renunciation but actual renunciation of the original citizenship is not required). ... n.a.
